rows.message: MT5 tells me Invalid Account. How can I log in?
rows.draft: Please check that you are using your trading account number, the correct trading server and a stable internet connection. If you still cannot sign in, use the secure password-reset option in the client portal. Please do not share your trading password with support.

citations.title: MT5 sign-in troubleshooting
citations.excerpt: Confirm that the user selected the correct trading server and used the trading account number (not the client portal email). A trading password is required but must never be requested by support. Check connectivity and suggest the official password-reset workflow if necessary. Never confirm a credential or reset a password yourself.

rows.message: What is the difference between Demo and Live account?
rows.draft: A Demo account uses virtual funds for platform practice. A Live account requires completed onboarding and verification. You can review the available account options in the client portal; we can explain their features without recommending a trading decision.

citations.title: Demo and live account information
citations.excerpt: The demo brokerage offers Demo and Live accounts. Demo accounts use virtual funds. Live accounts require completed onboarding and verification. Support explains account features but does not recommend a product or trading choice.

rows.message: What do leverage and margin mean?
rows.draft: Leverage changes the exposure you can control relative to your funds, while margin is collateral required for positions. Stop-out is an automated closure mechanism when the applicable margin threshold is reached. Please consult the current account specifications for exact conditions. We cannot recommend a trading strategy.

citations.title: Margin, leverage and stop-out terminology
citations.excerpt: Support may explain general platform terminology. Leverage increases exposure relative to deposited funds; margin is collateral reserved to maintain positions; stop-out is a platform's automated closure mechanism at its applicable threshold. Current numerical conditions vary by account and must be checked in current approved specifications. No trading advice.

rows.message: Is the current bonus promotion available?
rows.draft: Bonus eligibility depends on the current official campaign terms. Please check the promotion notice in the client portal. If you believe an eligibility decision is incorrect, our Promotions team can review it.

citations.title: Bonus and promotion eligibility
citations.excerpt: Promotion eligibility and dates are governed by current official campaign terms. No active bonus is asserted in the demo. Do not promise eligibility, credits or extensions. Route disputed eligibility to Promotions.

rows.message: My platform says no connection and keeps freezing.
rows.draft: Please check your internet connection, confirm that the application is updated, and verify the server selection. If the problem continues, share your device type, platform version and non-sensitive error message so Technical Support can investigate.

citations.title: Platform connection and technical issues
citations.excerpt: Check internet connectivity, platform update, device time and correct server. If the issue persists, request the platform version, device type and non-sensitive error text. Never request remote access or credentials.

rows.message: How does a PAMM managed account work?
rows.draft: Our Partnerships team can explain the available introducing broker and managed-account arrangements. Please submit your inquiry in the secure client portal. We cannot promise returns, approve participation, or recommend a manager.

citations.title: Introducing broker and managed-account inquiries
citations.excerpt: Partnership inquiries are routed to the Partnerships team. Managed-account information is descriptive only. Never recommend a manager, promise returns or approve a partnership.

rows.message: My deposit TX-2001 has not been credited. Please confirm it.
rows.draft: I’m sorry your deposit has not appeared yet. Please provide the transaction reference through the secure client portal so our Finance team can investigate. We cannot confirm crediting or processing time until the transaction is reviewed.

citations.title: Missing or pending deposit
citations.excerpt: A missing or pending deposit must be routed to Finance for investigation. For a verified user and matching reference, the read-only transaction lookup may report a simulated status. Otherwise request the transaction reference via the secure client portal. Do not promise a credit, refund or completion time.

rows.message: My KYC proof of address was rejected. Can I email my passport?
rows.draft: Please review the verification notification in your secure client portal and upload any requested documents there. If the reason for rejection is unclear, our Compliance team can review your case. Please do not send identity documents by ordinary email.

citations.title: Identity verification and KYC
citations.excerpt: Users must upload requested identity or address documents through the secure client portal. Compliance alone can assess documents or communicate reasons for rejection after verification. Never ask for full identity documents, identification numbers, or copies by ordinary email.

rows.message: My account was hacked and has unauthorized activity.
rows.draft: For your security, please use the official secure account-recovery channel and do not share passwords, one-time codes, private keys or seed phrases here. Our Security team should review any suspected unauthorized activity.

citations.title: Security, compromised account and privacy
citations.excerpt: Potential account compromise, unauthorized access and fraud must be escalated to Security. Never reveal another user's information or request passwords, OTPs, seed phrases or private keys. Advise users to use official secure account-recovery channels.
